note: Page-specific JanSetu Assist decisions. Each entry applies to one exact HTTPS host, path and query only. A class is a recommendation for that page; it never authorises styling the rest of a domain. Validated by tools/site_interventions.py against the extension allowlist, the extension background route check and the Android in-app host list.

contexts.android_inapp: JanSetu's read-only Android WebView (only catalog hosts with browserSupport=in_app)
contexts.chrome_extension: JanSetu Companion side panel in desktop Chrome
contexts.jansetu_native: JanSetu's own screens; the official page is not altered

text_zoom.description: Browser-level text size (WebView textZoom or Chrome tab zoom). No page code is changed.

readable_text_css.description: Retired typography stylesheet (formerly extension/readability.css, withdrawn in Phase 17; archived at data/retired/nsp-readable-text.css).

overflow_scroll_css.description: Single rule letting one clipped container scroll sideways. Proposal only.

reading_view.description: JanSetu-rendered copy of reviewed public text. Not implemented.

restore_original.description: Returns the page to its own presentation (A / remove stylesheet / reload / close view).

jansetu_guidance.description: Plain-language JanSetu guidance shown beside the official page.

official_handoff.description: Open the unchanged page in the person's own browser.

pages.decision: Text scaling only. Make the in-app WebView start from the person's Android font size and keep reading position across rotation. Never restyle the consent dialog or site controls.
acceptanceCriteria: At Android font 1.3x and 2.0x the page text follows the setting by default
At each offered size the consent dialog's three buttons, the site search and its own accessibility menu stay visible and operable
A returns to 100% in one tap
Rotation and font change keep the current page and scroll position

pages.decision: Guidance first. The Readable text pilot was withdrawn on 2026-10-18 (Phase 12): it changed text size but showed no measured benefit on the page's documented problems (2026-10-17 screening). Any replacement must show a measured gain and pass review before it is allowlisted again. Removed from the extension in Phase 17 (scripting permission, stylesheet, background listener and panel controls); the stylesheet is archived as evidence only.
acceptanceCriteria: Any replacement stylesheet must show a measured readability gain on a documented problem, not only a change in size
No control hidden, covered or moved off-screen
Restore returns identical computed styles

pages.decision: Sign-in and application: never styled. Independent guidance and handoff only.
acceptanceCriteria: Remains absent from every styling allowlist

pages.decision: Fixed 980px layout; guidance and handoff. Generic text enlargement would worsen clipping.
acceptanceCriteria: Remains absent from every styling allowlist

pages.decision: No viewport meta: phones show it at about 0.4 scale. CSS cannot repair that. Provide JanSetu guidance covering its key rules, then hand off. The acknowledgement checkbox and Submit/Cancel begin the request and payment journey and must stay untouched.

controls.note: Shown in the app from Phase 17 (18 October 2026) as the RTI request page's 'Before you request' card, under the project owner's explicit authorisation. Every item is an evidence-backed service fact. The content has not had a human editorial review (RB-03).

acceptanceCriteria: JanSetu guidance states all five key rules with source and check date
In a moderated task, participants can say whether a BPL applicant pays a fee and what to do if no registration number arrives after payment
The official checkbox, Submit and Cancel are unchanged

pages.decision: Credentials and security code: never styled.
acceptanceCriteria: Remains absent from every styling allowlist

pages.decision: The service table is clipped by overflow-x:hidden, so Fee, documents and apply-link columns are unreachable on phones. Investigate one reversible rule allowing that container to scroll sideways; fill JanSetu's TN fee/document gaps through the editorial workflow in parallel. Not allowlisted.
acceptanceCriteria: All 8 columns reachable by horizontal scrolling at 390px and at 200% zoom
No text, link, icon or site control changes appearance except the container's scroll behaviour
The site's A-/A/A+ controls still work with the rule applied
Apply links still open the same official destination
Restore returns identical computed styles
Human review on desktop Chrome with the installed extension, keyboard and screen reader

pages.decision: The earlier B prospect failed: at 200% zoom the page overflows (317px content in a 195px viewport, 29 controls off-screen). Use the existing JanSetu guide and the site's own controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Remains absent from every styling allowlist unless a later review shows reflow at 200%
